content.title: Hoax or history?
content.description: Examine an actual exchange about Jesus' death, resurrection and the competing interpretations of the sources.

claim.text: Craig defends the resurrection as the best explanation of the evidence. Ally disputes that inference and discusses an alternative account of Jesus' fate.

content.hinge: Which points are claims about the sources, which are historical inferences, and which depend on theological expectations?
prompts: Read both opening contributions before judging the replies.
Track the difference between crucifixion, death and resurrection.
Test the explanatory costs of each proposed account.
